description: This file defines a custom exception class ResourceNotFoundException used within a Java backend project to signal that a specific resource could not be found. It extends RuntimeException and includes additional fields for resource type and identifier.

classes.name: ResourceNotFoundException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating a requested resource was not found, containing resource type and identifier fields.

methods.name: ResourceNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with resource type and identifier, and setting exception message.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the type of the resource that was not found.

methods.name: getIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the resource that was not found.
